meta.notes: Defines the sound event msm_starter:music_disc.my_song. It plays the vanilla file records/cat for now: choose Import assets, then Sounds, and pick your own .ogg (for example my_song.ogg; it is stored as sounds/my_song.ogg in this namespace), then change name to msm_starter:my_song (the path under sounds/ without .ogg). stream: true plays long music without loading it all at once.
